# appsignal_organization (Data Source)

An AppSignal organization, looked up by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appsignal_organization" "this" {
  slug = "example"
}

# For example, hand the push API key to a collector through a secret store.
output "push_api_key" {
  value     = data.appsignal_organization.this.push_api_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `push_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Organization-wide push API key.
